messages:
brynn: heads-up  lucas' birthday is next Thursday (10/12). small ideas: surprise desk plant + card, pizza box lunch at 12:30, or virtual card + charity donation. quick pulse? :tada:
jin: plant sounds sweet and low-maintenance. happy to water for the first week if someone volunteers to be backup.
lucas: omg no pressure y'all! i'm usually in that day. totally fine with any of those options :)
izzy: pizza would be fun but can we do individually boxed slices or personal pies? less sharing = less drama. also gf pizza option pls.
brynn: noted. plant = low mess; pizza = lunchtime energy; virtual donation = low-effort remote-friendly. react with :herb: = plant, :pizza: = boxed pizza, :envelope_with_heart: = virtual card + donation, :x: = opt out.
events-bot: POLL created "Lucas birthday pulse"  Options: 1) Surprise desk plant + card 2) Boxed pizza lunch @12:30 3) Virtual card + donation 4) Opt out. Voting window: 24h
omar: if plant wins i can swing by GreenThumb at 11:00 and grab a small pot. who can sign for delivery at reception around 11:15?
jin: i can sign. happy to be backup water-er for week 1.
izzy: if pizza wins i'll order 8 personal pies (including GF) from Pies & Co and drop at reception. budget cap $72? i'll collect $6 via venmo.
brynn: quick note: lucas doesn't love candles or loud singalongs, so let's skip those. simple card msg ideas welcome.
lucas: haha no singing please. short card line: "Happy Birthday Lucas! Thanks for keeping the code clean and the standups short."
izzy: love that.
events-bot: Poll update: 10 votes  5 :herb:, 3 :pizza:, 1 :envelope_with_heart, 1 :x:
brynn: plant is leading. final check: any allergies to plants (rare) or strong scents? lucas: nope, no allergies. scent-free is fine.
omar: plant pickup confirmed. i'll add a small note tag on the pot. brynn can we write the card together tomorrow?
brynn: yes i'll start a card thread here. jin will sign, izzy can add a quick note about team appreciation.
lucas: you all are the best. no fuss needed but this means a lot. seriously appreciate the thought <3
events-bot: Poll closed. Winner: Surprise desk plant + card. Final tally: 5 plant, 3 pizza, 1 donation, 1 opt-out.
